verdict.rationale: Expensify docs show SmartScan auto-reading receipt data and card import/BYOC, which implies some receipt-to-transaction linkage, but there is no explicit evidence of automatic e-receipt pulling from partner integrations or of a nudge system that only fires when a receipt is genuinely missing. Community reports also flag inconsistent categorization and slow processing, undercutting confidence in the 'smart' matching claim. Missing for 10: explicit e-receipt integration sourcing, documented auto-match-to-card-transaction logic, and evidence of a targeted 'missing receipt' nudge feature.
